limitations: Deleting the Version that carries the Executed pin clears the pin through the foreign key's SET NULL. OpenLaw records document.version_deleted but no document.executed_cleared entry, so History does not say the pin was cleared. The guide tells the reader to mark the correct Version again rather than promising a History line.
The Partially signed Status name is seeded data. An Administrator can rename it but cannot archive or delete it. The guide uses the seeded name, as it does for Out for signature.

The registry's 'unsupported users cannot perform the legal action' is covered by the guide's role prerequisite and the archived-record sentence. A Business User sees no executed-copy controls in the Portal; the guide states the supported roles rather than naming every refused role.
